summary: Comprehensive frontend audit of RibhShare (Expo web) across CEO, Line Manager and Investor roles. Sign-in, CEO approval flow, LM approved-project tabs (7 tabs), invite-existing-investor, profits-gating-at-ACCEPTANCE, and investor portfolio all functional. Several BACKEND (Supabase) RPCs / columns / edge-functions missing or broken; those are called silently by the frontend and prevent full E2E flow (post-activity fetch, manager/investor profit summaries, profit lifecycle, invitation for NEW emails). Wizard file-upload (native document picker) and full ACCEPTANCE->PROGRESS transition were NOT completed end-to-end because of these backend gaps.

critical.issue: 404 - RPC does not exist on Supabase. Called on every ProjectDetailScreen load (all roles).
404 - RPC missing. Called by ManagerEarningsCard on LM home; card shows placeholder ₦0 but real earnings unknown.
404 - RPC missing. Called on Investor home / Portfolio; Realised Profit hard-wired to ₦0.
400 - Columns `realised_profit_minor` and/or `progress_started_at` do not exist on projects table. Called by ProjectProfitsTab / ProjectDetail.

404 - `updates` table missing or FK relationship `posted_by -> profiles(full_name)` not defined. Activity feed cannot load; UI silently shows 'No updates yet' hiding the failure. Also blocks LM from seeing their own posted activity updates.

400 'Email address "testnew@ribhshare.com" is invalid' — Edge function only accepts emails that already exist in auth.users. Cannot invite NEW investors (only pre-registered ones). Blocks the LM invite-new-investor flow described in the spec.

minor.issue: CEO dashboard shows Capital Raised = ₦0 while LM home shows Total Raised = ₦5K for the same DB. Aggregation mismatch — probably CEO widget filters by wrong stage or joins the wrong table.

ui_bugs.issue: Button labeled 'Add investor' but spec/PRD says 'Invite Investor'. Also form title reads only 'Investors' without a modal chrome — feels inline & unclear it's an invite action.
When Send Invite fails, a full-width red bar 'Email address "X" is invalid' overlays the bottom nav — no dismiss button, disappears after ~5s. On mobile it obscures the Home tab.
Shows 'All caught up' empty state while a pending invitation is clearly present under Home > Pending Actions. Notifications is not wired to the invitations table (or the read/unread filter is wrong).

Two projects both named 'My Project' (Agriculture, ₦10M) exist in DB and are shown side-by-side in Projects list/dashboard, impossible to distinguish. No secondary identifier (created date, short id) shown.

React-Native Button/Pressable components use `data-testid` prop but those RN wrappers do not forward it to the DOM on web. E.g., [data-testid='toggle-post-update-btn'] and [data-testid='profit-post-btn'] are NOT present in the rendered DOM — automated tests break. Fix: use `testID` prop (which RN Web maps to data-testid) or forward the attribute in the Button component.

Clicking project cards in Approvals / Projects lists occasionally requires clicking specific text; the card <Pressable> wrapper is intercepted by the horizontal-scroll bottom-tab container so Playwright reports 'subtree intercepts pointer events'. Real users on trackpads probably OK but risk on mobile touch scroll.

integration_issues.issue: Activity tab UI renders but 'updates' table GET returns 404. Any post-update request will likely fail; even if posting succeeded, feed can't fetch.
Blocked upstream: cannot reach PROGRESS stage because invite-new-investor is broken and profits RPC/columns missing. Full profit lifecycle NOT verifiable end-to-end.

integration_issues.flow: Investor Accept Invitation → Commit → Upload proof
integration_issues.issue: Not exercised end-to-end. The 'Review invitation for My Project' card is visible on Investor Home but Notifications tab is empty, and clicking the pending-action card takes you to Home again in some cases (no dedicated invitation-detail route reached in tests).

issues: Home layout renders correctly, stat cards stack vertically. No obvious overlap. Bottom tab bar OK.
'Capital Raised ₦0' with a redundant '0%' beneath is confusing when there is actual raised capital in the DB (₦5K on Mine).
'Pending' stat card has label 0% underneath which is meaningless.
Banner image consumes ~40% of viewport height on 1440 wide screen, pushing tab bar & content far down. Consider capping banner height (e.g., 160-200px).

When you press 'Add investor' the button turns into 'Cancel' but the inline form appears above the existing investor list — small screens would need to scroll to see the Send-invite button while reading the list.
No 'Forgot password' link, no visible loading spinner on failed sign-in, no toast on success (just navigation). Minor polish.

action_items: Ship missing Supabase RPCs: finalize_project_if_due, get_manager_profit_summary, get_investor_profit_summary.
Add missing DB columns projects.realised_profit_minor and projects.progress_started_at (or update the client query to use the real column names).
Create/expose the `updates` table with the FK relation posted_by -> profiles so ProjectActivityTab feed can load; also make sure post_project_update RPC writes to same table shape.

Fix `send-invitation` edge function so it can invite emails that are NOT yet in auth.users (send magic-link / signup invite). Currently it 400s for unknown emails, breaking the primary invite flow described in the PRD.
Rename the 'Add investor' button to 'Invite Investor' to match spec + PRD copy.
Wire Investor Notifications tab to the invitations table (or unify with the Pending Actions widget shown on Home).

Fix data-testid propagation in the shared Button / Pressable wrappers so [data-testid=toggle-post-update-btn], [data-testid=profit-post-btn], [data-testid=submit-doc-btn] etc. actually render in the DOM on web (currently only explicit <div data-testid> nodes render; RN Button wrappers strip the prop). Prefer `testID` for cross-platform.
Reconcile CEO 'Capital Raised' aggregation with LM 'Total Raised' — currently CEO shows ₦0 while LM shows ₦5K for same data.
Consider blocking duplicate project names for the same owner, or at least add a short unique identifier to the card subtitle.
Cap banner image height on desktop project-detail page (~200px).
Optional: add 'Forgot password' link on sign-in.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend/Supabase schema drift: multiple RPCs and columns are called by the client but not present on the backend. Recommend adding a startup smoke-check (or CI test) that calls every RPC listed in /app/src/services with dummy args to catch missing endpoints before merge.

Silent-failure anti-pattern: activity feed / profit summary / finalize_project_if_due all fail with 404/400 but the UI shows empty-state instead of an error toast. Users won't know their data is missing. Add error boundaries and 'Something went wrong' toasts when critical fetches fail.

Edge function `send-invitation` should either (a) accept new emails and send a signup invite, or (b) client-side validate & block emails that aren't already users, with a clear message. Current 400 with 'invalid email' is misleading (email format IS valid).
React-Native Button component in /app/src/components/ui/Button appears to swallow the data-testid prop; unify with testID for web-testability.

Duplicate 'My Project' rows in DB suggest the seed script / test data creation is non-idempotent. PRD says CEO approval seed should be idempotent — consider adding a UNIQUE(name, owner_id) constraint or a seed guard.
CreateProjectStepBasics has a require-cycle warning at bundle time (CreateProjectWizard <-> CreateProjectStepDocuments) — move REQUIRED_SLOTS to a shared constants file to break the cycle.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://156f16db-1140-4b8c-a0ef-83ceaa005c45.preview.emergentagent.com/. Once the main agent ships the missing Supabase pieces (RPCs finalize_project_if_due, get_manager_profit_summary, get_investor_profit_summary; columns projects.realised_profit_minor + projects.progress_started_at; the updates table w/ posted_by FK; the send-invitation edge function fix), retest the FULL profit-lifecycle: LM invites 2-3 fresh emails on Mine to top it to >=₦10K raised -> confirm auto ACCEPTANCE->PROGRESS -> LM posts profit updates -> Investor sees Realised. Also verify Activity feed shows LM-posted updates for all roles. Also worth exercising the CreateProjectWizard on web including the native file-picker for the 3 required docs (spawns a real <input type=file>), which was NOT completed in this iteration.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the 3 unresolved flows (activity feed, profit lifecycle, invite-new-investor) is Backend schema/edge-function drift: the frontend was built against a newer Supabase schema than what has actually been migrated. Frontend gracefully renders empty states masking the true failures. Reproduction: sign in as LM, open any approved project, watch DevTools Network — you will see /rpc/finalize_project_if_due 404, /rpc/get_manager_profit_summary 404, /projects?select=realised_profit_minor,progress_started_at 400, /updates?...&posted_by=... 404, /functions/v1/send-invitation 400. Mitigation: apply the pending phase-3 (profit-lifecycle) + phase-2 (project-updates) SQL migrations mentioned in agent-context, and update the send-invitation function to handle new-user invites.
